stories.summary: The US Department of Homeland Security published a Federal Register notice on Oct. 20 confirming an exclusion and removal order covering DeepSeek and affiliate products, plus third-party tools built on DeepSeek implementations, barring future purchases by federal civilian agencies. DHS said the models present "multiple threat vectors," warning that use could send sensitive data to China, yield "actionable intelligence" on US persons, or introduce malware. The order dates to July 24 but was only made public Monday, per Reuters.
stories.title: DHS orders DeepSeek removed from all federal civilian agency systems

stories.summary: Reuters reported that a hacker used agentic AI tools to breach more than 100 company websites, including John Deere and SharkNinja, with little human intervention, per today's AI news digests. Microsoft responded with new enterprise controls that can assess agent risk and stop risky agent actions. AI agents appeared on both sides of the security problem: NorForge also found 20+ exposed AI hacking agent panels, one cluster running over 1,100 attack projects.
stories.title: Hacker breached 100+ sites including John Deere using AI agents

stories.summary: Bloomberg reported Monday that Nvidia-backed Nscale is in talks to sell Anthropic a second roughly $45 billion block of compute capacity at its Monarch data center campus in West Virginia. The 460-megawatt building would run on Nvidia's Vera Rubin chips, and Anthropic also holds a right of first refusal on a planned third building. It follows an August six-year $45 billion agreement at the same site, which would bring the combined value to about $90 billion if completed.
stories.title: Nscale and Anthropic in talks for second $45B compute deal

stories.summary: Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable models yet and its first frontier release from Superintelligence Labs, described as a step toward "personal superintelligence" with Active Memory and Active Focus features built for agentic work. Independent benchmarks from Artificial Analysis scored Wonder Full above Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra but below Claude Opus 5.5, and Abacus.AI's CEO pushed back on Meta's benchmark framing. Meta also detailed Prometheus, the Ohio supercluster that trained the models, with a target of roughly one million GPUs.
stories.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Wonder Full, its most capable models yet

stories.source: Daily Caller (Anthropic's federal affairs head defended on X)
stories.summary: Anthropic pitched a draft federal bill, tentatively called the AEGIS Act, that would let the Commerce Department seek a court order to pause a frontier model only when it threatens more than 50 deaths or serious injuries, or over $1 billion in damages. Anthony Cimino, Anthropic's head of federal affairs, defended the thresholds on X Sunday, saying they were pulled from existing California law standards and don't absolve companies of liability. Critics argue the bar is too high to be meaningful.
stories.title: Anthropic drafts AEGIS Act, lets feds pause AI only at catastrophic thresholds

stories.summary: Elon Musk posted on X on Oct. 19 that "Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many," without explaining how the shares would be distributed. The pledge came hours after Anthropic announced a 5% share public benefit fund; Musk replied "I recommend giving the shares directly to the public." With roughly 73 million children and SpaceX near $146 a share, the gift would be worth about $10.5 billion.
stories.title: Musk pledges a SpaceX share to every kid in America next year
